name: Astrid Flamel
original_name: アストリット・フラメル
source:
She is the next Grand Master of Kimia, a township composed entirely of magicians. She specializes in alchemy, including the creation of golems.

In addition to her own research, she is passionate about training apprentices. Currently, she has three girls with rich personalities as her apprentices. Sh is somewhat a bit of a nag, but that is only out of consideration for her students. She is well-liked and respected by her students.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1014490]Getchu[/url]]
